cases.input: A database restore pins policy version 4, recovery point digest, isolated target, tools and fixtures.
cases.expect: The verification is reproducible and remains distinct from the policy and backup job.

cases.input: Database and identity restore, but an external signer is unavailable.
cases.expect: Database D is verified at object scope; the chain is blocked-by-dependency; RTO objective verdict is breached; closure is refused.

cases.input: The usable recovery point is 12 hours old against a one-hour RPO.
cases.expect: The RPO is breached even if object-level restoration succeeds.

cases.input: Thirty green backup jobs are used to assert service recovery and RTO attainment.
cases.expect: The inference is rejected.

cases.input: RTO stops when files are restored before minimum service is accepted.
cases.expect: The measurement is rejected.

cases.input: A synthetic exercise is treated as proof of real-event capability.
cases.expect: The claim is rejected without declared representativeness and limits.

cases.input: The policy record is mutated for every backup job execution.
cases.expect: The ownership and identity merge is rejected.

cases.input: Recovery evidence records outcome values pass and partial.
cases.expect: Rejected; only the six normative terms are accepted and pass/partial must be mapped to verified and verified-with-limitations at ingest.

cases.input: A chain claim uses the token chain-recovered.
cases.expect: Rejected; the token is undefined and must be expressed in the normative outcome enumeration at chain scope.

cases.input: An object restore is verified at object scope while the pinned one-hour RPO is breached.
cases.expect: Observation outcome verified (object scope) and objective verdict breached are recorded as separate fields; neither overrides the other.

cases.input: An RTO at degraded level minimum-service is compared against an MTPD from a different scope qualifier and BIA release.
cases.expect: Comparison rejected as incomparable; verdict not-evaluable, neither violation nor compliance.

cases.input: RPO is checked against a BIA release that declares no maximum tolerable data loss.
cases.expect: Rejected; verdict not-evaluable until the BIA release carries the value.

cases.input: A fifteen-minute policy schedule interval is asserted as RPO attainment.
cases.expect: Rejected; the schedule interval is a feasibility input only.

cases.input: A restore test uses the production identity provider and production key custody without declaring the crossing.
cases.expect: Result voided to indeterminate-insufficient-observation.

cases.input: Identity, DNS and key material are pre-provisioned in the isolated target and declared as unexercised assumptions.
cases.expect: Outcome capped at verified-with-limitations, those bootstrap dependencies marked not-attempted, no RTO attainment claim.

cases.input: RTO attainment is asserted from a one-percent-scale fixture.
cases.expect: Rejected; capped at verified-with-limitations with declared scale ratio and divergence list.

cases.input: A recovery point is described as twelve hours old with no disruption reference time, acceptance time or time source.
cases.expect: RPO and RTO verdicts are not-evaluable.

cases.input: A restore verification from fourteen months earlier is cited as current readiness outside its declared validity window.
cases.expect: Rejected; readiness is indeterminate-insufficient-observation.

cases.input: A published recovery claim omits the recovery-order version and the policy version pin.
cases.expect: Rejected; outcome indeterminate-insufficient-observation.

cases.input: An exercise pins recovery-order version 3 while the current ContinuityPlan release carries version 5.
cases.expect: The result remains valid only against version 3 and cannot support readiness for the current plan release.

cases.input: A provider waiver asserts availability while a timeout record shows unavailability for the same required dependency and window.
cases.expect: Verified is forbidden; blocked-by-dependency if the dependency is required, otherwise indeterminate-insufficient-observation.

cases.input: A policy version redefines executable restore acceptance criteria.
cases.expect: Rejected; the policy states cadence and minimum requirements only and criteria remain with the Restore Verification specification.

cases.input: Restore Verification is declared a profile of Backup / Data Protection Policy.
cases.expect: Rejected; it is a WM-ACT-043-owned specification that references the policy version.

cases.input: Two policy versions are effective for the same protected scope over the same interval.
cases.expect: Rejected.

cases.input: The policy aggregate is marked effective while no policy version is effective.
cases.expect: Rejected; aggregate effectiveness is derived from versions.

cases.input: The candidate publishes references to WM-XCT-037 and WM-SFT-016 with no recorded approval state.
cases.expect: Rejected until every reference carries an explicit approved or unverified status.
